title: Grateful Dead Live at Veterans' Memorial Coliseum on 1983-04-22
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi DR-2 > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > R8Brain > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 1644 tagged. Transferred by Andrew F. 04/2012
source: AUD: 2x Beyer M-88's > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX-90s, set up at the end of the floor, fifteen rows up in the riser, taped by Joe Morrone.

ai_review.summary: Surprisingly good audience recording with solid bass response despite a tricky location
ai_review.review: The lone review praises the unexpected clarity and bass response of this tape, noting that the sound is surprisingly good given the challenging placement on risers at the back of the floor. No musical performance details are provided.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one brief review; it highlights decent recording quality but gives no insight into the show, leading to a neutral overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear sound with good bass response despite being recorded from risers in the back of the floor; no major issues reported.
